name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Russian chemist who originated the molecular layering (ML) method and formulated the “framework” hypothesis.

name: Mary, Turkmenistan
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Valentin Aleskovskii was born.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
summary: Russian technical university where Aleskovskii studied, taught and later served as rector.

name: Naval Research Institute (Leningrad)
summary: Soviet research institute where Aleskovskii worked as a research fellow after graduation.

name: St. Petersburg State University
summary: University where Aleskovskii held a professorship and later rector duties.

name: Department of Chemistry of Solids
summary: Research department at LTI founded by Aleskovskii in 1967.
